Riti Beauty is a luxury bridal makeup artist in Mumbai, trusted by 500+ brides since 2016. With 9+ years of experience, we specialize in HD bridal makeup, soft glam, and natural bridal looks for weddings across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Thane.
Our bridal services cover every event- engagement, haldi, mehendi, sangeet, bridal, and reception makeup along with hairstyling, saree draping, and jewellery setting for brides, bridesmaids, and family.
Every look is customized to your skin type, outfit, and venue lighting, so your makeup looks flawless in person and in photographs. We use long-lasting, sweat-resistant techniques designed for Mumbai's climate, keeping you confident from your first event to your last dance.
Limited bookings only.

Looking for the best bridal makeup artist in Mumbai?

At Riti Beauty, we specialize in bridal makeup, creating personalized looks that truly match you.

But a bride’s glow isn’t complete without the entire look. We also offer professional makeup services for bridesmaids, making sure your full bridal party looks picture perfect.

And it’s not just about weddings. We provide makeup services for every occasion.

And the best part? We regularly run exciting offers for our brides.

Take a look at my portfolio below and see the transformations for yourself.

WhatsApp me now to book your session.
Whether you’re planning your engagement, wedding, sangeet, mehendi, haldi, reception, or pre-wedding shoot, this video shows you exactly how we create timeless, elegant bridal looks that last from the first ritual to the final farewell.

featured_reviews.name: Yashika Gohil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came across Riti on Instagram and finalised her for my engagement after just one telephonic conversation. That’s how comfortable and confident she made me feel from the very beginning.

What I loved the most about her is that she truly listens. She understands exactly the kind of look you want and executes it beautifully. I was looking for a very minimal, soft glam and realistic look, and she absolutely nailed it. My makeup looked flawless yet natural. I genuinely felt like a princess, and everything was just on point.
Her behaviour is extremely kind and calming, and she is very punctual, which really matters on such important days. She did my makeup, hairstyle, and draping, and everything was done perfectly.
I had also hired her for my mom and for the groom’s touch-up. My mom looked absolutely gorgeous and was very happy with her look. We received so many compliments throughout the event!
She also assisted me during the shoot, making sure my makeup stayed in place at all times. Another great thing is that she uses high quality branded products that last even during long hours and peak sunlight. I have sensitive skin, and I’m so happy to say I didn’t face any breakouts afterwards.
Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would highly recommend her to any bride looking for a natural yet stunning look. ❤️
